text: The amazing victory allows you to scale the first two ACHIEVEMENT RUNGS on your ECHELADDER. You are now a PLUCKY TOT, with a new feather in your cap to show for it.
The ECHELADDER rewards your bold ascent with 125 BOONDOLLARS. You waste little time in storing them in your CERAMIC PORKHOLLOW.
Additionally, climbing the rungs has boosted your GEL VISCOSITY and CACHE LIMIT.
alt: A victory screen appears. John's rank climbs the ECHELADDER from GREENTIKE, to JUVESQUIRT, to PLUCKY TOT. His cache limit and gel viscosity increase, and he receives 125 of some type of currency.
